FEATURES_TITLE: Amiquus is your always-on car scout
FEATURES_SUBTITLE: While you focus on running your business and life, Amiquus quietly scans the market, filters the noise and delivers only actionable car opportunities straight to your Telegram.
HOW_SUBTITLE: Get started in minutes and begin receiving alerts for the vehicles that actually fit your strategy.
HOW_STEP1_DESC: Define the deals you actually want to see: brands, models, age, mileage, price range, fuel type, gearbox and regions. Create multiple profiles for different niches (e.g. wagons, EVs, budget stock).
HOW_STEP2_DESC: Link your Telegram account in a guided setup that takes under two minutes. From then on, every important listing lands directly in a chat you already use on desktop and phone.
HOW_STEP3_DESC: Decide how aggressively you want to compete: from relaxed hourly checks to high-frequency scans every few minutes. Faster checks mean earlier alerts and a stronger first-mover edge.
HOW_STEP4_DESC: Whenever a new listing matches your filters, Amiquus sends a concise alert: photos, title, price, key specs, location and a direct link. One tap to open the ad, another tap to call or message the seller.
HOW_STEP5_DESC: Pause niches that are full, tighten price bands, add new regions or plug in another website. You stay in control of the strategy – Amiquus simply follows your latest settings.

HOW_EXAMPLE_NOTE: Tip: Using a real alert screenshot builds trust and shows how actionable each notification is in daily work.

HOW_STEP5_DESC: Zaustavite polne segmente, prilagodite cene, dodajte regije ali nove strani. Kontrola je pri vas – Amiquus sledi vašim nastavitvam.
